N01.name: Laurel Marquise Necklace
N01.note: it is held in a woman's open hand in a shop, in front of other necklaces on a maroon velvet board: ignore the hand, the board and every other necklace, and take only the marquise-stone necklace lying across the palm.
N01.lock: A MARQUISE LEAF NECKLACE: one continuous line of clear MARQUISE-cut (navette, pointed oval) faceted stones, each about 5x10mm in its own gold four-claw setting. The stones are grouped in THREES: in every group the three marquise stones are set on a SLANT, side by side and slightly overlapping like three leaves on a stem, all leaning the same way. Each group of three is joined to the next by one small gold link, so the line reads as a row of leaf clusters with a tiny gap between them. Warm polished gold tone settings.
N01.neg: Every stone is a pointed marquise, never round, never pear, never baguette; the stones lie on a slant in groups of three, never in one straight end-to-end row, never in pairs; no pendant, no drop, no plain chain section; clear stones only, no colour.
N01.scale: Each marquise stone is about 10mm long and 5mm wide; the line of stones is about 9mm wide, about half the width of a finger.
N01.wscale: Worn, the line of marquise clusters lies around the base of the neck like a slim sparkling collar, about half a finger wide, never a heavy bib.
N01.place: laid on the top face in a long smooth curve, the slanted clusters of three legible, part of the line running over the cube's front edge
N01.macro: three or four of the slanted marquise clusters in their gold four-claw settings and the small gold links between them
N01.palm: the necklace gathered in the open palm, the line of marquise clusters lying across the palm and over the fingers
N01.pscale: Each marquise stone is about as long as the width of a fingernail; the line of stones is about half a finger wide.

N02.name: Soleil Petal Pendant
N02.note: it is held between a woman's fingers over a black velvet tray, with a white pouch and cards behind it: ignore the hand, the tray and the packaging, and take only the pendant and its fine chain.
N02.lock: A HALF-SUNBURST PETAL PENDANT on a fine gold snake chain: at the top centre ONE round brilliant-cut clear stone, about 7mm, held up in gold claws; SEVEN slender polished gold PETALS fan out below and beside it only, close together like the rays of a rising sun: one points straight left, one down-left, one steeply down-left, one straight down, one steeply down-right, one down-right and one straight right, each a narrow open loop of polished gold about 10mm long with a rounded tip, all springing from just under the stone. Nothing rises above the stone: the upper half of the pendant is bare and the snake chain passes behind the stone. The pendant is about 28mm across and about 16mm tall.
N02.neg: Exactly seven petals, all in a half fan from left round the bottom to right, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows; no petal above the stone, never a full circle of petals, never a pinwheel; the petals are slim open loops, never solid flat leaves, never pave, never sharp star points; one clear stone only; no second pendant.
N02.scale: The pendant is about 28mm across, about the width of a large coin; the stone is about 7mm, smaller than a fingernail.
N02.wscale: Worn, the pendant is small: about 28mm across, a little more than half the width of her lips, its stone about 7mm; it sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N02.place: laid flat on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pendant at its point, its seven petals fanned below the stone
N02.macro: the round clear stone in its claws at the top and the seven polished gold petals fanning out below it
N02.palm: the pendant lying flat in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N02.pscale: The whole pendant is about as wide as two fingers side by side; its stone is about half as wide as one finger.
N02.measure: 2 Nov, from the owner's photo: the pendant spans about 1.8 finger widths (about 27 to 30mm), the stone about 0.28 of the pendant (about 7 to 8mm). The first worn and palm shots drew it about 1.7 to 2 times that and were shrunk by edit.

N03.name: Pearl Crescent Pendant
N03.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch held in a woman's hand: ignore the hand, the pouch and its reflections, and take only the pendant and its chain. The pearl is a smooth round white shell pearl with a soft lustre. In this photo the chain happens to lie looped around the left side of the pendant inside the pouch: that loop is only how it was packed, NOT part of the design; ignore it.
N03.lock: A PEARL CRESCENT PENDANT on a fine gold box chain with a small sliding bead: ONE round white pearl, about 10mm, with a soft creamy lustre; a slim CRESCENT of about eight small round clear stones, each in its own little gold collar, curves around the RIGHT side and the BOTTOM of the pearl, from the top right round to the bottom left, like a new moon; the upper LEFT side of the pearl is bare, just the smooth pearl. The pendant hangs from ONE small gold bail at the top, where the chain passes through; from the bail the fine chain runs straight up on both sides, like any pendant necklace.
N03.neg: One pearl only, round and white, never pink, grey or golden; the crescent of small clear stones follows only part of the pearl's edge, never a full halo; the chain NEVER wraps around the pearl, never forms a loop or a gold rim on the pearl's left side and never crosses over the pendant; no other drop; the chain is a fine square box chain, never a rope or cable, never chunky.
N03.scale: The pearl is about 10mm, about the size of a fingernail; each crescent stone is about 2mm.
N03.wscale: Worn, the pendant is small: the pearl is about 10mm, about a fifth of the width of her lips, and the whole pendant with its crescent about 14mm; it sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine box chain.
N03.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pearl crescent pendant at its point
N03.macro: the white pearl and the curve of small clear stones in their gold collars beside it
N03.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine box chain trailing over the fingers
N03.pscale: The pearl is about the size of one fingernail; the whole pendant is no wider than one finger.

N04.name: Molten Solitaire Pendant
N04.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch on a black tray, the pouch held by a hand: ignore the hand, the pouch, the tray and the cards, and take only the pendant and its chain.
N04.lock: A MOLTEN SOLITAIRE PENDANT on a fine gold cable chain: ONE round brilliant-cut clear stone, about 8mm, sunk inside an irregular, organic frame of polished gold that looks like molten gold poured around it, with soft uneven ripples and folds on its rim, the frame about 12mm across; the chain passes through a chunky irregular gold loop at the top.
N04.neg: The frame is irregular, rippled and asymmetric like molten metal, never a neat round bezel, never claws; one clear stone only; no pave; a plain cable chain.
N04.scale: The pendant is about 12mm across, about the size of a fingernail.
N04.wscale: Worn, the molten pendant, about the size of a fingernail, sits just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N04.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the molten pendant at its point
N04.macro: the clear stone sunk in its rippled molten gold frame and the chunky gold loop above it
N04.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N04.pscale: The pendant is about the size of a fingernail.

N05.name: Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace
N05.note: it is in a clear pouch on a white card printed with a butterfly, a dashed line, words and a necklace icon, held in a hand: ignore the hand, the pouch, the card and all its printing, and take only the necklace.
N05.lock: A PETITE PEAR SOLITAIRE NECKLACE: ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 6x8mm, held in fine gold claws, hanging from a TINY round gold bead bail about 1.5mm across, with the stone's narrow pointed tip at the TOP and its round end at the BOTTOM, on a fine gold cable chain whose links are about 2mm long.
N05.neg: One pear stone only, clear, never coloured, never a pearl; it hangs point up; no halo, no pave, no second drop, no bar.
N05.scale: The pear is about 8mm long and 6mm wide, smaller than a fingernail and only about three chain links wide; the bail is tiny, about 1.5mm, about a quarter of the stone's width, never a big ball.
N05.wscale: Worn, the pendant is small: the pear is about 8mm long and 6mm wide, about a sixth of the width of her lips, hanging just below the hollow of the throat on the fine chain.
N05.place: laid on the top face, the chain in a soft V and the pear at its point
N05.macro: the pendant resting on the cube's top face with the fine cable chain running away from its tiny bail in both directions: the clear pear-cut stone in its fine gold claws, point up, and the TINY gold jump-ring bail above it, with several chain links in frame
N05.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers
N05.pscale: The pear is about a third of the width of one finger and the bead bail a tiny dot.
N05.measure: Owner's photo (refs/N05_full): the stone is about 75 x 90 px; the fingers holding the card are about 190-220 px across (about 16 mm) and the cable links about 22 px (about 2 mm), so the pear is about 6 x 7.5 mm, a standard 6 x 8 mm stone, with a bead bail of about 20 px (1.7 mm). The 2 Nov photos drew it about 10 x 14 mm worn, 4.4 chain links wide on the cube (3.4 in hand) and about 1.2 finger widths in the palm, so all were remade on 3 Nov. 3 Nov gallery: packshot edit N05_He (pear about three links wide, tiny bail); W1e and W2e from it (pear about 6.5 x 8.5 mm against the lips); macro N05_Mf; palm N05_Pf = the blended palm frame N05_Pcs with its oversized pendant cloned out from palm texture 170 px below and the true-size cut-out (comp/n05_pendant_cut.png, 0.1286, rotated 40 degrees) pasted on the chain, about 45 x 55 px against 100-110 px fingers.

N06.lock: A PETITE FLOWER Y NECKLACE on a fine gold cable chain: at the centre front ONE tiny FLOWER, about 6mm, of five small round clear stones as petals around a tiny gold bead centre, where the chain's two arms meet in a V; from the flower a single fine gold chain drop about 5cm long hangs straight down, ending in a tiny polished gold flower charm.

N06.palm: the necklace lying in the open palm, the tiny flower in the centre and the fine drop running down over the fingers

N07.name: Asscher Solitaire Pendant
N07.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch on a black velvet tray: ignore the pouch and the tray, and take only the pendant and its chain.
N07.lock: AN ASSCHER SOLITAIRE PENDANT: ONE clear octagonal step-cut (Asscher-cut) stone, about 9mm, its four corners cut off so its outline is an eight-sided octagon, with deep step facets like a hall of mirrors, held in fine gold claws at its corners; a SLIM polished gold bail with a single ridge, only about half as tall as the stone; on a FINE, delicate flat gold curb chain about 1mm wide, roughly an eighth of the stone's width, its links tiny.

N07.scale: The stone is about 9mm, about the size of a fingernail; the chain is about 1mm wide.
N07.wscale: Worn, the pendant is small: the stone is about 9mm, about a fifth of the width of her lips, and the fine chain is a thread-thin line; it hangs just below the hollow of the throat.

N07.macro: the octagonal step-cut stone in its gold claws and the ridged gold bail above it
N07.palm: the pendant lying in the centre of the open palm, its fine chain trailing over the fingers

The first worn shots drew the stone about 13mm, the palm shot about 19mm, and the packshot chain about three times too thick.

A16.name: Herringbone Teardrop Necklace
A16.note: it lies in a white plastic pouch held in a hand: ignore the hand and the pouch, and take only the necklace.
A16.lock: A HERRINGBONE V TEARDROP NECKLACE: a flat polished gold herringbone chain about 3mm wide that, at the centre front, turns into TWO short smooth polished gold TUBE BARS, each about 15mm long and as wide as the chain, which meet at a point to form a sharp V; from the point of the V hangs ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 8x11mm, its narrow tip at the TOP joined to the point of the V, its round end at the BOTTOM, held in fine gold claws.

A08.name: Bow and Heart Gift Set

A13.name: Slim Pave Huggies
A13.detname: IMAGE 2 is a flat DRAWING of ONE huggie seen exactly side-on and the authority on its SHAPE and proportions: a rounded square as deep as it is tall, a slim band, the row of stones down its front edge and the hinge seam in its top edge; it is a drawing, so take only its outline and proportions from it, never its flat colours.
A13.note: they hang through two holes in a small white card printed STAINLESS STEEL, inside a clear plastic bag held in a hand, each seen at an angle with its back half behind the card: ignore the hand, the bag, the card and its printing, and take only the pair of earrings.
A13.lock: A PAIR OF SLIM PAVE HUGGIES: each is a slim gold hinged huggie shaped as a ROUNDED RECTANGLE with straight sides and softly rounded corners, about 18mm tall and about 10mm front to back; the band is slim, about 2mm wide. ONE row of about ten small round clear stones, each held by tiny gold claws, runs down the face of the FRONT edge only, from the top corner to the bottom corner; the top, the bottom and the back are plain polished gold; a hinged click post in the top edge.
A13.neg: The huggie is a rounded rectangle with straight sides, never a round hoop, never an oval, never twisted or wavy; one single row of stones, on the front edge only, never on the top, the bottom or the back; no drops, no charms.
A13.place: the two huggies standing upright side by side on the top face, closed, each turned so its rounded-rectangle side outline faces the camera with the stone row on its front edge
A13.macro: ONE huggie standing upright on its flat bottom edge, seen from the side so its whole rounded-rectangle outline is in frame: its straight front edge with the row of small round stones in tiny gold claws runs straight up one side, the plain polished back edge up the other, the hinged post at the top
A13.palm: the pair of huggies lying side by side in the centre of the open palm, each closed, the stone rows facing up
A13.scale: Each huggie is about 18mm tall and about 10mm front to back, about the size of a fingertip; the band is about 2mm wide and each stone about 1.3mm.
A13.wscale: Worn, the slim huggie hangs from the piercing: its stone row runs about 18mm straight down the front of the lobe, about as long as the earlobe is tall, its bottom only about a centimetre below the bottom of the earlobe and the whole huggie about a third of the height of the whole ear; a slim line of light, never a big hoop.
A13.pscale: Each huggie is about as tall as one finger is wide, a little more, and the pair together covers well under half the palm.
A13.measure: Owner's 2 Nov photo, same STAINLESS STEEL card as A12: the huggie is 250-257 px tall against a 690 px card (A12: 309 px hoop, 1039 px card, 15 mm), so about 1.22 x the A12 hoop, about 18 mm; the thumb and a USB cable give 19-22 mm. Stones about 14 px at a 19 px pitch, about ten in the row. The 31 Oct listing assumed 13 mm from the buy-book photo. Shape: the hoop passes through the card, so its plane is steep to the camera and its bottom (108 px) is foreshortened; the true depth is 0.6 to 1.0 of the height, and the owner's 31 Oct note on this piece was 'Square, it is an earring'. The first packshot (A13_H) drew a 3:1 paperclip and was replaced. Five packshots were drawn: the generator will not make the outline square (A13_Hs edit 2:1, A13_Hq 2.5:1, the drawing-guided edit A13_Hd 2.4:1); A13_Hg, a fresh packshot guided by the flat outline drawing refs/A13_shape.jpg, came out about 1.9:1, which matches the outline the huggies show in the owner's photo, and was approved.
